task: Trim leading/trailing whitespace from chat folder names at store write points and defensively at render points, plus fix a sentinel-collision edge case surfaced in code review

component_scope.label: M
component_scope.affected: chatsStore (createFolder, renameChatFolder, moveChatToFolder, startNewChat, createChat), FolderList, SearchResultItem, MoveChatPopup, FolderFormPopup (investigated, no-op)

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: Initial pass missed 3 edge cases (DOM-id/data-folder slug trim, DEFAULT_CHAT_FOLDER sentinel-collision guard in createFolder/renameChatFolder, SearchResultItem visibility-gate trim) — surfaced and resolved in code review, not a requirements ambiguity

technical_risk.label: S
technical_risk.risk_factors: Trivial string normalization, no security/perf implications; only subtlety was DEFAULT_CHAT_FOLDER sentinel collision after trimming
technical_risk.mitigation: Guarded sentinel-equality checks against the trimmed value in createFolder/renameChatFolder

key_reasoning.reason: Five components touched (one store, three render, one investigated-only) but all follow the same trim pattern with no architectural coordination
Requirement itself was unambiguous (trim whitespace); the 3 review findings were implementation edge cases, not requirement gaps
